threads.body: [Testing] Please retain `1.3.8.RELEASE` for this regression fixture. `Repackager` embeds the loader from its own release, so this update makes `LegacySpringBootLogCorrelationSmokeTest` exercise the 1.5 loader instead of the intended 1.3 loader. The existing loader-class-name check does not distinguish these versions, so the test can pass while losing 1.3 log-correlation coverage.

@copilot Update this PR directly with these two scoped changes, preserving all unrelated dependency updates.

Restore org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-loader-tools to 1.3.8.RELEASE in smoke-tests/images/spring-boot-1.3/build.gradle.kts. In .github/renovate.json5 add a packageRules entry with matchFileNames: ['smoke-tests/images/spring-boot-1.3/build.gradle.kts'], matchPackageNames: ['org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-loader-tools'], and enabled: false. Include a short comment explaining that this preserves the Spring Boot 1.3.8 classloader regression fixture. Repackager embeds its own release's loader; Boot 1.5 lacks the getResource/getResources overrides that the 1.3 regression exercises, despite sharing the same class name. Keep the fixture assertions unchanged.

Revert the Error Prone core upgrade from 2.50.0 to 2.51.0 in dependencyManagement/build.gradle.kts and examples/distro/buildSrc/src/main/kotlin/otel.nullaway-conventions.gradle.kts. Keep core at 2.50.0 because the 2.51.0 SafeRE memory regression is unresolved for this build, tracked at https://github.com/google/error-prone/issues/6230. Preserve the independent gradle-errorprone-plugin update and other dependency updates. Do not add heap increases or warning suppressions to accommodate 2.51.0.

Run the narrow relevant configuration/format validation where feasible. Acceptance criteria: the regression fixture still uses exactly 1.3.8.RELEASE, Renovate will no longer update that dependency in that one file, both Error Prone core pins remain 2.50.0, and unrelated changes remain intact.

replies.body: Applied in `1ff536fd`: restored the Spring Boot 1.3.8 fixture and both Error Prone 2.50.0 pins, and disabled Renovate updates for that loader dependency in the fixture file.
